1: // Simple reflex game: catch falling stars
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: if (!canvas) throw new Error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.width || 400;
6: canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
7: 
8: // Audio setup
9: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10: function playSound(frequency, duration, type='sine') {
11:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:   osc.type = type;
14:   osc.frequency.value = frequency;
15:   osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:   osc.start();
18:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19: }
20: function playCatchSound(){playSound(600,0.07,'triangle');}
21: function playGameOverSound(){playSound(200,0.5,'sawtooth');}
22: 
23: // Ensure audio context runs after user interaction
24: window.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
25:   if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
26: });
27: 
28: // Player settings
29: const player = {
30:   x: canvas.width / 2,
31:   y: canvas.height - 30,
32:   radius: 20,
33:   speed: 5,
34:   dx: 0,
35: };
36: // Background stars for ambiance
37: const backgroundStars = [];
38: const bgStarCount = 100;
39: for (let i = 0; i < bgStarCount; i++) {
40:   backgroundStars.push({
41:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
42:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
43:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
44:     speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
45:   });
46: }
47: // Particles for catch effect
48: const particles = [];
49: 
50: // Star settings
51: const stars = [];
52: const starRadius = 10;
53: const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
54: let lastSpawn = 0;
55: let score = 0;
56: let gameOver = false;
57: 
58: // Input handling
59: const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
60: window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
61:   if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true;
62: });
63: window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
64:   if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false;
65: });
66: 
67: function updatePlayer() {
68:   if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.dx = -player.speed;
69:   else if (keys.ArrowRight) player.dx = player.speed;
70:   else player.dx = 0;
71:   player.x += player.dx;
72:   // keep inside canvas
73:   if (player.x - player.radius < 0) player.x = player.radius;
74:   if (player.x + player.radius > canvas.width) player.x = canvas.width - player.radius;
75: }
76: 
77: function spawnStar(timestamp) {
78:   if (timestamp - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
79:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * starRadius) + starRadius;
80:     stars.push({ x, y: -starRadius, radius: starRadius, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
81:     lastSpawn = timestamp;
82:   }
83: }
84: 
85: function updateStars() {
86:   for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
87:     const s = stars[i];
88:     s.y += s.speed;
89:     // collision with player
90:     const dx = s.x - player.x;
91:     const dy = s.y - player.y;
92:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
93:     if (dist < s.radius + player.radius) {
94:       // create catch particles
95:       for (let p = 0; p < 8; p++) {
96:         particles.push({
97:           x: s.x,
98:           y: s.y,
99:           vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
100:           vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 - 1,
101:           life: 30,
102:           radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
103:         });
104:       }
105:       stars.splice(i, 1);
106:       score++;
107:       playCatchSound();
108:       continue;
109:     }
110:     // missed star => game over
111:     if (s.y - s.radius > canvas.height) {
112:       gameOver = true;
113:     }
114:   }
115: }
116: // Update background ambient stars
117: function updateBackgroundStars() {
118:   for (const bs of backgroundStars) {
119:     bs.y += bs.speed;
120:     if (bs.y > canvas.height) {
121:       bs.y = 0;
122:       bs.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
123:     }
124:   }
125: }
126: // Update particles (fade out)
127: function updateParticles() {
128:   for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
129:     const p = particles[i];
130:     p.x += p.vx;
131:     p.y += p.vy;
132:     p.life--;
133:     if (p.life <= 0) {
134:       particles.splice(i, 1);
135:     }
136:   }
137: }
138: 
139: function draw() {
140:   // Background gradient
141:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
142:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00172d');
143:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003366');
144:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
145:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
146: 
147:   // Ambient background stars
148:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
149:   for (const bs of backgroundStars) {
150:     ctx.beginPath();
151:     ctx.arc(bs.x, bs.y, bs.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:     ctx.fill();
153:   }
154: 
155:   // Particles (catch effect) with fading
156:   ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
157:   for (const p of particles) {
158:     const lifeRatio = p.life / 30;
159:     ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${lifeRatio})`;
160:     ctx.beginPath();
161:     ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
162:     ctx.fill();
163:   }
164:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
165: 
166:   // Player with radial gradient
167:   const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
168:     player.x, player.y, player.radius * 0.2,
169:     player.x, player.y, player.radius
170:   );
171:   playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#88c0ff');
172:   playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5e81ac');
173:   ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
174:   ctx.beginPath();
175:   ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
176:   ctx.fill();
177: 
178:   // Stars with glow effect (five‑point stars)
179:   for (const s of stars) {
180:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,215,0,0.8)';
181:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
182:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
183:     // draw five‑point star
184:     const spikes = 5;
185:     const outerRadius = s.radius;
186:     const innerRadius = s.radius * 0.5;
187:     const step = Math.PI / spikes;
188:     // start at first outer point
189:     let a0 = -Math.PI / 2 + Math.atan2(s.y - player.y, s.x - player.x);
190:     ctx.moveTo(s.x + Math.cos(a0) * outerRadius, s.y + Math.sin(a0) * outerRadius);
191:     ctx.beginPath();
192:     for (let i = 1; i < 2 * spikes; i++) {
193:       const r = i % 2 === 0 ? outerRadius : innerRadius;
194:       const a = i * step - Math.PI / 2 + Math.atan2(s.y - player.y, s.x - player.x);
195:       ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a) * r, s.y + Math.sin(a) * r);
196:     }
197:     ctx.closePath();
198:     ctx.fill();
199:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset
200:   }
201: 
202:   // Score text with subtle shadow
203:   ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
204:   ctx.shadowBlur = 2;
205:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
206:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
207:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
208:   ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
209: }
210:     ctx.closePath();
211:     ctx.fill();
212:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset
213:   }
214: 
215:   // Score text with subtle shadow
216:   ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
217:   ctx.shadowBlur = 2;
218:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
219:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
220:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
221:   ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
222: }
223: 
224: function loop(timestamp) {
225:   if (gameOver) {
226:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
227:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
228:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
229:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
230:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 60, canvas.height / 2);
231:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
232:     return;
233:   }
234:   updatePlayer();
235:   spawnStar(timestamp);
236:   updateStars();
237:   updateBackgroundStars();
238:   updateParticles();
239:   draw();
240:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
241: }
242: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
